description: This file defines the TimerRegistry class, which manages the registration and creation of timers within the Orleans runtime. It provides methods to register general grain timers and grain-specific timers, utilizing internal timer classes and interactions with grain contexts.

classes.name: TimerRegistry
classes.description: Implements ITimerRegistry to handle timer registration for grains, supporting both general and grain-specific timers, with dependency injection for logging, time management, messaging, and silo details.

methods.name: RegisterTimer
methods.description: Registers a general-purpose timer for a grain context, with callback and timing options.

methods.name: RegisterGrainTimer
methods.description: Registers a grain-specific timer with configuration options like interleave and keep-alive, returning a timer instance.
